name: CE_PAYMENT_DOCUMENTS_
description: CE_PAYMENT_DOCUMENTS_ is the audit table for CE_PAYMENT_DOCUMENTS. CE_PAYMENT_DOCUMENTS contains information related to payment documents.

columns.name: PAYMENT_DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: Uniquely identifies the payment document.

columns.name: PAYMENT_DOCUMENT_NAME
columns.description: Name of the payment document.

columns.name: PAYMENT_INSTRUCTION_ID
columns.description: Uniquely identifies the payment instruction.

columns.name: INTERNAL_BANK_ACCOUNT_ID
columns.description: Uniquely identifies the bank account.

columns.name: PAPER_STOCK_TYPE
columns.description: Paper stock type. Possible values are blank and prenumbered.

columns.name: ATTACHED_REMITTANCE_STUB_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate whether attaching remittance stub is allowed. Possible values are yes or no.

columns.name: NUMBER_OF_LINES_PER_REMIT_STUB
columns.description: Number of Lines per Remittance Stub

columns.name: NUMBER_OF_SETUP_DOCUMENTS
columns.description: Number of documents printed at the beginning of each automatic payment batch.

columns.name: FORMAT_CODE
columns.description: Payment format code used for the payment document.

columns.name: FIRST_AVAILABLE_DOCUMENT_NUM
columns.description: First payment number available on a payment document.

columns.name: LAST_AVAILABLE_DOCUMENT_NUMBER
columns.description: Last payment number available on a payment document.

columns.name: LAST_ISSUED_DOCUMENT_NUMBER
columns.description: Last payment number used on a payment document to pay invoices.

columns.name: MANUAL_PAYMENTS_ONLY_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate whether manual payment is allowed. Possible values are yes or no.
